question: Padma Shri awardee Guru Keezhpadam Kumaran Nair was a dancer of which of the following classical dances of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kathakali **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Keezhpadam Kumaran Nair (1916–2007) was a **Kathakali** artist from Kerala, India.
 
• Kumaran Nair was one of very few Kathakali artists to have directly interrelated with** allied art forms like ****Bharatanatyam from south India and Kathak from the north of his country besides also Odissi from the eastern belt. **
 
• Kumaran Nair** retired from stage three years before his death in 2007** and led a completely reclusive life in his house in a quiet, northern corner of his native Vellinezhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Smitha Rajan** (born in 1969) is an Indian Mohiniyattam performer from Kerala and** granddaughter of the legendary Indian classical dancer couple of Padma Shri Kalamandalam Krishnan Nair and Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma.**
 
• Sonal Mansingh, (born April 30, 1944, in Bombay, India), is a **dancer of Odissi, a classical Indian** dance form that originated in Orissa, and other Indian classical forms.
 
• **The world famous Kathak dancer, Pandit Birju Maharaj** is the face of the Kalka-Bindadin Gharana of Lucknow.
